basis: Author approved 128m/four sectors/2m passages/78 distributed essences/24 traps (8 of each kind), 60 active seconds to rearm and 3 seconds to rescue. Textures, light and headroom reuse the sewer arena. Pit depth reuses MAP02's -160 return level. Crusher speed reuses MAP02. Timed doors use native slow close/wait/open (16,240). Grid placement and seed are deterministic geometry, not a balance change. One hunter may rebuild a bounded grid route at most once per active second.
